game_window: Three ERA5 hours: the kickoff hour and the next two. Wind and temperature are means; precipitation is the sum of the three hourly values.

methodology.schedule_nfl: nflverse games.csv regular season and playoffs, completed games with a listed kickoff.
methodology.schedule_cfb: CFBD games when a college-football data key is configured; otherwise the ESPN FBS scoreboard. Completed games only.
methodology.weather: Open-Meteo archive hourly series at the stadium coordinates (ERA5, about a 0.25 degree grid, not a field sensor).
methodology.outdoor: Open roofs include every completed game. Retractable roofs include only games tagged open or outdoors. Domes are omitted. An unknown retractable state is omitted.
methodology.kickoff_window: Local stadium time. before 3pm, 3-6pm, 6-9pm, and after 9pm.
methodology.sample_size: N is games in that month and kickoff window. Thin cells are not for ranking venues.
methodology.totals: No betting totals, prices, or win-loss records.
